_comment: The new WSL distribution's additions to adoption/templates/claude.settings.template.json. Only tools/adoption/new_wsl_client_config.py reads this file (the `_comment` key is not a setting and is never rendered): it merges the keys below into the shared template (a key both files define is refused) and wires each through adoption/new-wsl/client-config-map.json, so the shared template stays what the bootstrap applies on every other host. The two allow rules name semble's tools exactly, so Claude Code calls them without asking outside bypass mode and an upstream upgrade cannot add an allowed tool silently (wave-2 code-search ruling, change 3); an allow rule grants a permission, so the map classes them authorization: written only with --with-authorization-settings and only while the code-search slot installs semble. The env variable turns Claude Code's agent teams on (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams), which the owner's directive of 2026-10-04 names (docs/decisions/2026-10-04-new-wsl-token-layer-default.md); a run that needs plain named subagents passes the variable as 0. The enabledPlugins entry turns on the built-in mod cc-plugin-you-should-know (a side agent that shows notes above the prompt, added in Claude Code 2.1.287; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview, read 2026-10-04) under the owner's order of 2026-10-04 to enable the latest changelog features on both hosts; the ConfigChange hook is the logging-only audit hook of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide ('Audit configuration changes') with the same literal command NativeStack runs. remoteControlAtStartup true starts the Remote Control bridge in every interactive session (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control.md#L198); Claude Code honors a true only from user or managed settings, never from project or local ones (settings.md#L741), so only this user-scope file can carry it. On a bypassPermissions host it is a remote ingress, so the map classes it authorization, and the tool makes it a separate opt-in inside that class, off by default: written only with --with-authorization-settings and --with-remote-control-at-startup together, and never over a value the file already has (docs/decisions/2026-10-17-new-wsl-remote-control-at-startup.md).

hooks.command: jq -c '{timestamp: now | todate, source: .source, file: .file_path}' >> ~/claude-config-audit.log || true
